title: Compliance Intake Prioritization — Account-Aware Phased Roadmap
creator: Aisha Malik
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit diverse security and compliance requests (SOC2 gaps, ISO checklists, HIPAA scoping, GDPR/DPA data flow questions, and long vendor questionnaires). Current intake is ad hoc: requests land in PM/Support threads, handoffs to Security are manual, prioritization is inconsistent across accounts and offers poor visibility to customers.

Goal: Build an account-aware triage and prioritization flow for compliance asks that: 1) classifies request type and urgency, 2) assigns a risk & effort score, 3) surfaces recommended SLAs and routing (self-serve, PM-led, Security review), and 4) provides an evidence-bundle template for common asks. This should scale intake velocity, reduce manual churn for Security SREs, and produce predictable customer commitments.

Scope (MVP):
- Intake form enhancements + webhook into Intake Queue.
- Automated classifier (rule + lightweight ML/heuristics) to tag requests: {SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, GDPR, DPA, Vendor Questionnaire, Other}.
- Account-aware priority scoring (customer tier, active deals, legal hold, production impact).
- Routed lanes: Self-serve (low-effort evidence pack), PM-managed (coordinate with SE), Security review (high-risk/legal).
- Evidence-bundle templates (SOC2 artifact checklist, DPA/residency FAQ, vendor questionnaire starter).

Out of scope for MVP: full LLM automation of answers, audit-grade automated evidence gathering, on-prem installer changes.

Success criteria: shorter mean time to first response, reduced Security manual triage time, clear SLA commitments on routed lanes.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form captures standardized metadata (request type, account, contract id, requested due date)
Automated classifier tags >= 85% of incoming requests correctly on a validation set
Priority score computed for 100% of requests and used to auto-route to one of three lanes
Evidence-template link provided to customer/PM within 24 hours for routed tickets
Operational dashboard shows queue size, avg time-to-route, and SLA adherence
work_items: Design: intake form updates (UX copy, required fields, attachments)
Engineering: webhook + queue schema changes; classifier integration endpoint
Security: define risk & evidence templates and routing rules
PM: build prioritization rubric and escalation matrix
Data: create validation dataset from last 12 months of tickets for classifier training
DX: email/portal copy for automated responses and SLA commitments
Analytics: dashboard + KPIs wired to console (avg TTR, SLA by lane, misclassification rate)
risks: Classifier mislabels high-risk requests -> delayed security review
Over-automation could produce boilerplate answers that fail legal review
Insufficient metadata from customers results in manual follow-ups and negates time savings
Resource contention with security team during rollout
Edge cases (multi-jurisdiction DPAs) require manual escalation and bespoke engineering work
measurement: Mean time to first route (target: <= 8 hours for P0/P1, <= 24 hours for P2)
Reduction in Security manual triage time (target: 40% reduction in week 12 vs baseline)
Classifier precision/recall on held-out dataset (target precision >= 0.85)
% tickets with evidence bundle delivered within SLA (target >= 90%)
Customer satisfaction score on compliance asks (CSAT > 4.2 within 30 days)
